in_sanskrit.name: Ardrika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Durga
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ardrika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ardrika is a Sanskrit name derived from the term Ardra, which refers to the Goddess Durga. This name signifies strength, courage, and the power to overcome obstacles. It is believed that the Goddess Durga protects her devotees from all harms and evils. This name is considered auspicious and is often given to girls to bless them with divine protection and courage.
